spans.s:
योपन, अम्, n. the act of effacing (foot-prints
or traces, &c.) or anything used for effacing or obli-
terating; the act of oppressing, obstructing, molest-
ing, perplexing, confusing, destroying, effacing, obli-
terating (sometimes at the end of comps.; cf. पद-य्˚,
जन-य्˚).
योपन योपन. See under rt. युप्, p. 820.

योपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, effacing, obliterating,
obstructing, perplexing.
